chunks: And Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who has a debt and has collateral with him—may he purchase it? He said: "Yes."

key_terms.رَهْنٌ: collateral or pledged property held as security
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative legal response meaning yes

ai.seo_question: Can a creditor purchase collateral that is held against a debt?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a creditor who holds collateral for a debt. It indicates that purchasing the pledged item is permissible in this case.
